title: Career Roadmap: F&B Service Executive
summary: Career Domain: Travel, Tourism, Hospitality & Transport · Qualification Pathway: BHM / B.Sc Hospitality & Hotel Administration / BTTM – Hotel Management / Hospitality Administration · Target Career: F&B Service Executive

facts.Current degree: BHM / B.Sc Hospitality & Hotel Administration / BTTM

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: An F&B Service Executive serves guests in hotel restaurants, bars, banquets and room service, making sure food and drink are served well, safely and with great hospitality.
What a F&B Service Executive does

items.text: Welcome and serve guests and take orders
Explain the menu, dishes and beverages
Learn F&B service, kitchen and front-office basics
Practise table service, grooming and etiquette

blocks.text: Year 2: Service skills and food safety

items.text: Study menu knowledge, beverages and banquet service
Do your industrial training in a hotel
Learn wine, coffee or mixology basics
Learn POS systems and guest-feedback handling
Apply through campus placements to hotel chains

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
